issue.title: Restore editing headroom in the bob-ledger-tools reference page
issue.description: Proposed by bob-cli-ij.2 note #1. In bob-plugins docs/bob-ledger-tools.md, bob_docs.markdown.count_words reports 6000 words at 59df267^ and 5999 at 59df267; the mounted reference cap is 6000 (bob-cli tools/docs/bob_docs/lint.py). This is a capacity improvement, not a currently failing gate. Condense duplicated prose or extract one coherent section under the docs routing rules to leave meaningful editing headroom (target at least 300 words) without losing behavior, defaults, keybindings, or contract links and without raising the cap. Preserve inbound anchors or update their callers if a section moves. Use sase_repo for bob-plugins, read docs memory before editing, regenerate inventory if required, run npm run docs:check with explicit local mounts, and sync plugins per AGENTS.md. Size small: the cause and remedy are confined to an existing reference page and its links. Same-type/all-type searches and last-week sweeps found no duplicate; h9 and bh concern different Mac pages. Active epic scopes do not own this pre-existing documentation capacity problem.

task_type_fields.proposal: Give the bob-ledger-tools reference page meaningful room for future documented features through a bounded prose cleanup or coherent section split.
task_type_fields.why_out_of_scope: The page already consumed all 6000 words before bob-cli-ij; this epic reduced it by one word and its documentation passes. Broader reference maintenance is independent of nearest-note colors.

issue.creation_reason: Phase bob-cli-ij.2 found that even a short required documentation addition exceeded the existing page budget. Independent landing measurements confirm the page already had no headroom before the epic.
